// Generated by BIMOS Active Ragdolls (Tools > Active Ragdoll > Install BIMOS Demo Weapon Support).
// Safe to delete; regenerate from the same menu.
using System;
using System.Reflection;
using ActiveRagdoll;
using BIMOS;
using BIMOS.Samples;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ActiveRagdoll.BIMOSDemo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lets active-ragdoll NPCs pick up and fire the BIMOS demo <see cref="Pistol"/>. Shots go through the
    /// pistol's own <c>Fire()</c>, so they get its sound, slide recoil, muzzle flash, casing, bullet hole and
    /// knock-back exactly as when you fire it. NPCs can't seat magazines (BIMOS sockets only accept a
    /// magazine that a hand is holding), so by default NPC-held pistols have infinite ammo.
    /// Grabbing the pistol out of an NPC's hand disarms it.
    /// </summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    [AddComponentMenu("Active Ragdoll/BIMOS/BIMOS Demo Pistol (NPC)")]
    public sealed class BIMOSDemoPistolWeapon : NPCWeapon
    {
        /// <summary>When false, NPCs only fire rounds that are actually chambered, then drop the empty gun.</summary>
        public static bool InfiniteAmmoForNPCs = true;

        private const BindingFlags Private = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
        private const int Chambered = 2; // Pistol.CartridgeStatus.Chambered
        private static readonly FieldInfo s_status = typeof(Pistol).GetField("_cartridgeStatus", Private);
        private static readonly FieldInfo s_bullet = typeof(Pistol).GetField("_bullet", Private);
        private static readonly FieldInfo s_barrel = typeof(Pistol).GetField("_barrelTransform", Private);

        private Pistol _pistol;
        private Transform _barrel;
        private Transform _grip;
        private Grab[] _grabs = Array.Empty<Grab>();

        protected override void Awake()
        {
            _pistol = GetComponent<Pistol>();
            if (_pistol == null)
                _pistol = GetComponentInChildren<Pistol>();
            if (_pistol != null && s_barrel != null)
                _barrel = s_barrel.GetValue(_pistol) as Transform;
            if (s_status == null || s_bullet == null)
                Debug.LogWarning("[ActiveRagdoll] BIMOS demo Pistol internals changed; NPCs will only fire chambered rounds.", this);

            base.Awake();

            _grabs = RootTransform.GetComponentsInChildren<Grab>(true);
            foreach (Grab grab in _grabs)
            {
                // The main (not offhand) right-hand grip is where a palm goes.
                if (grab is SnapGrab && !(grab is OffhandGrab) && grab.IsRightHanded)
                {
                    _grip = grab.transform;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        public override Transform Muzzle => _barrel != null ? _barrel : base.Muzzle;
        public override Transform Grip => _grip != null ? _grip : base.Grip;

        public override bool IsHeldExternally
        {
            get
            {
                foreach (Grab grab in _grabs)
                    if (grab != null && (grab.LeftHand != null || grab.RightHand != null))
                        return true;
                return false;
            }
        }

        public override bool HasAmmo => (InfiniteAmmoForNPCs && s_status != null && s_bullet != null) || IsChambered;

        private bool IsChambered => _pistol != null && s_status != null && s_bullet != null
            && Convert.ToInt32(s_status.GetValue(_pistol)) == Chambered && (bool)s_bullet.GetValue(_pistol);

        public override bool NPCFire(GameObject shooter)
        {
            if (_pistol == null)
                return false;

            if (InfiniteAmmoForNPCs && s_status != null && s_bullet != null)
            {
                s_status.SetValue(_pistol, Enum.ToObject(s_status.FieldType, Chambered));
                s_bullet.SetValue(_pistol, true);
            }
            else if (!IsChambered)
            {
                return false;
            }

            BIMOSDemoDamageBridge.CurrentShooter = shooter;
            BIMOSDemoDamageBridge.CurrentMuzzle = Muzzle;
            try
            {
                _pistol.Fire();
            }
            finally
            {
                BIMOSDemoDamageBridge.CurrentShooter = null;
                BIMOSDemoDamageBridge.CurrentMuzzle = null;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
